title: papaver dubium var. errabundum
intro: Papaver dubium var. errabundum, commonly known as the Yellow Poppy, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family. It is primarily valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to induce a deep and restorative sleep. The health benefits of Papaver dubium var. errabundum include its use as a sedative and anxiolytic, helping to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including alkaloids and glycosides, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include inducing sedation and potentially reducing inflammation.
